label: D1 after unrewarded common a2->S2, strongest after a prior reward
terms: (phase == D1) * last_is("a2 S2 u") ;; (phase == D1) * last_is("a2 S2 u") * (tv("reward", -2) == 0) ;; (phase == D1) * last_is("a2 S2 u") * (tv("reward", -2) == 0) * (tv("state", -2) == 2) ;; (phase == D1) * last_is("a2 S2 u") * belief_lo ;; (phase == D1) * (prev_action == -1) * (in_rew == 0) * (belief < 0.5) ;; (phase == D1) * (prev_action == -1) * (in_rew == 0) * (belief >= 0.5) ;; (phase == D1) * last_is("a2 S2 u") * (tv("reward", -3) == 0)
explanation: Fires only at D1; zero at GO and D2. Its magnitude is set almost entirely by the previous trial being a2 -> S2 common and unrewarded (about +0.6 to +0.75 over timing; that one indicator alone gives dev R^2 0.46 beyond timing). Within that pattern, magnitude is graded by how surprising the omission is: it is largest (~1.3-1.4) when the trial before was rewarded, drops (~-0.33) when the trial before was also unrewarded (partly restored, +0.17, if that earlier miss was also at S2), and drops again if the trial three back was unrewarded. A higher ideal-observer log-odds that S1 is good lowers it slightly (graded, negative weight). On the first trial of a window, where the previous trial is not in the window, an unrewarded D1 with belief favouring S2 stands in for the a2 S2 u pattern. Other previous-trial patterns, the choice/state, the hidden good state and time since reversal add nothing. Test R^2 beyond timing 0.54, against an all-observed ceiling of 0.52 and an all-cues ceiling of 0.56, so dropping model value/policy loses essentially nothing (policy-decile alone was only 0.09).

issues: Numeric overstatement: the explanation says the feature is 'largest (about 1.3 to 1.4)' when the trial before was rewarded. Those values are the top actuals in the worst-fit windows, not the typical level. Fitting indicators split by reward two trials back gives +0.77 over timing after a reward vs +0.37 after a miss (test R^2 0.517). With D1 timing at about 0.1, the typical value is about 0.85-0.9, not 1.3-1.4.

Large residual spread remains inside the a2 S2 u case. Misses shows actuals of 1.4 against predictions of 0.16-0.19, and actuals of 1.0-1.2 against predictions of 0.5-0.8. The largest errors are on the first trial of a window (prev_action == -1), where the stand-in (unrewarded D1 split by belief) gets weights of only +0.20 / +0.08. Adding graded belief_lo or belief_cover to that stand-in adds nothing (test 0.535-0.536). Only the future variable 'this trial's choice' helps (test 0.549). So this gap comes from the data window (the previous trial is outside it), not from a missing observed cue.

The 'earlier miss was also at S2' wording is slightly off. When the term is split, choosing a2 two trials back carries the effect (+0.19), and reaching S2 adds about nothing (-0.02). Test R^2 rises to 0.543 from 0.538.

The three-back term is not a separate effect. When interacted with 'unrewarded two back', most of it moves into the interaction (-0.14), and the stand-alone three-back weight shrinks to -0.05. 'Drops 0.11 more' really means after two misses in a row.

Checks that held up: the feature is exactly zero at GO and D2 in the timing profile. The single a2 S2 u indicator scores test 0.457 beyond timing. The full term set scores test 0.5377, matching the claim and above the observed-only ceiling of 0.52. The belief_lo term is real (0.457 -> 0.495 alone). Adding a1 S2 u and other previous-trial patterns gives no gain. Misses shows no systematic phase or pattern error beyond a uniform -0.048 intercept leak on other D1 patterns and +0.02 at GO/D2.
